## CredentialsModule.acceptRequest() method

Accept a credential request as issuer (by sending a credential message) to the connection associated with the credential record.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
acceptRequest(credentialRecordId: string, config?: {
        comment?: string;
        autoAcceptCredential?: AutoAcceptCredential;
    }): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Type                                                                                                 | Description                                                          |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| credentialRecordId | string                                                                                               | The id of the credential record for which to accept the request      |
| config             | { comment?: string; autoAcceptCredential?: [AutoAcceptCredential](./core.autoacceptcredential.md); } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the credential |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;
